name: Olza / Oltza Zendea (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the arms of the Cendea de Olza (a field of wheat beneath a sun on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Olza; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
